segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Good morning.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Good morning. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I understand that the school organises ... umm, trips to different ...

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, we run five every month: three during weekends and two Wednesday afternoon trips.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: What sort of places?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Well, obviously it varies, but always places of historical interest and also which offer a variety of shopping. because our students always ask about that ... and then we go for ones where we know there are guided tours, because this gives a good focus for the visit.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Do you travel far?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Well. we're lucky here, obviously. because we're able to say that all our visits are less than three hours drive.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: How much do they cost?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Again it varies- between five and fifteen pounds a head, depending on distance.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Ah ha . ..

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh, and we do offer to arrange special trips if, you know, there are more than twelve people.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh right, I'll keep that in mind. And what are the times normally?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: We try to keep it pretty fixed so that, that students get to know the pattern. We leave at eight-thirty a.m. and return at six p.m. We figure it's best to keep the day fairly short.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh yes. And how do we reserve a place?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: You sign your name on the notice board. Do you know where it is?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Ah ha. I saw it this morning.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And we do ask that you sign up three days in advance so we know we've got ehough people interested to run it, and we can cancel if necessary, with full refund of course. ~AN : That's fine, thanks. ·

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: And what visits are planned for this term?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right, well I'm afraid the schedule hasn't been printed out yet, but we have confirmed the dates and planned the optional extra visits which you can also book in advance if you want to.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh that's all right. If you can just give some idea of the weekend ones so I can, you know, work out when to see friends, etcetera.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh sure. Well, the first one is St Ives. That's on the thirteenth of February and we'll have only sixteen places available 'cos we're going by minibus. And that's a day in town with the optional extra of visiting the Hepworth Museum.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh right . .. yeah . . . that sounds good

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Then there's a London trip on the sixteenth of February and we'll be taking a medium-sized coach so there'll be forty-five places on that, and, let's see, the optional extra is the Tower of London.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh, I've already been there.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: After that there's Ikis.tQl on the third of March.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Where?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Bristol .. . B-R-I-S-T-0 -L.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: OK . ..

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: That's in a different minibus with eighteen places available, oh, and the optional extra is a visit to the S.S. Great Britain.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: OK .. .

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: We're going to Salisbury on the eighteenth of March and that's always a popular one because the optional extra is Stonehenge, so we're taking the large coach with fifty seats . . .

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh good.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And then the last one is to Bath on the twenty-third of March.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh yes. Is Bath the Roman city?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, that's right, and that's in the sixteen-seater minibus.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: And where's the optional visit?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: It's to the American Museum- well worth a visit.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: OK, well that's great, thanks for all that . . .

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: My pleasure. By the way, if you want more information about any of the trips, have a look in the student newspaper.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: OK. .\'OMAN: Or, have a word with my assistant; her name is Jane ~-that's

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Right, I've got that. Thank you very much for all your help.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: You're very welcome. I hope you enjoy the trips.
